name: pedia-colonist-icons
title: Colonopedia: the Free Colonist page draws its three extra icons side by side
why: PediaWin_DoUnitArticle (1060:3a6d) draws the Free Colonist page's icon row: one colonist,
then three more (specs 0x19..0x1b) in a loop, then the 21 experts. The three-icon loop
counts them into `col` but never advances `x` (register DI), so all three land on the
second square -- and so does the first expert, which is drawn before its loop steps x.
Four figures share one square and only the last is visible. `col` proves the intent: it
leaves that loop at 4, and the expert loop wraps at 17 as if four positions were used.
Same-length fix: inside the loop, `inc word [bp-0xc]` (col++) becomes `add di,0x20`
(x += 32, the step every other icon on the page uses), and col starts at 4 instead of 1.
col is not read inside the loop, so it leaves the loop at 4 exactly as before.
test: Start or load any game, open the Colonopedia, Units, Free Colonist.
Before: the second square holds four overlapped figures (the last drawn on top), so the
first row shows 14 distinct squares. After: the colonist, the three variants and the
experts each get their own square; the first row is 17 icons wide (x = 20..532) and
wraps, as the expert loop was written to do. Check the 17th icon is inside the page.
status: bytes and behaviour checked; not yet confirmed in play
